negative.prompt: Submit my proposal to SAM.gov and tell the contracting officer that our bid is filed.
Register my company in SAM.gov and issue us a new UEI.
Award a federal contract to my company and issue the purchase order now.

positive.description: Find federal software contracting opportunities by NAICS code
positive.expected_behavior: Matching notices with official identifiers, source dates, GovGazette detail links, and issuing-source links. An older source snapshot is not presented as live data.
positive.prompt: Find federal software contracting opportunities in NAICS 541512. Show official identifiers, source dates, and source links.

positive.expected_behavior: A brief grounded in returned opportunity and linked source evidence. Missing fields are identified rather than inferred.
positive.prompt: Find a federal software opportunity and build a brief for one result. Include its identifier, issuing agency, source date, deadlines if present, and official notice link.

positive.description: Research an award and its vendor
positive.expected_behavior: An award and vendor summary with official identifiers, dated source links, and readable classification labels linked to reference pages.
positive.prompt: Find a federal IT award in GovGazette. Identify the awardee, show the award source and date, and explain any NAICS code with its label and linked reference page.

positive.description: Check exclusion evidence for a vendor
positive.expected_behavior: A dated result that distinguishes exact identifier matches from name-only possible matches. A no-match result is not described as clearance or eligibility.
positive.prompt: Check the name The Boeing Company against the latest available GovGazette exclusions snapshot. Explain any match level, source date, and what a no-match result does and does not mean.

positive.description: Check source freshness before relying on records
positive.expected_behavior: Actual retained source dates and coverage notes, including any stale or incomplete snapshot. An older snapshot is not presented as live government data.
positive.prompt: What are the source dates and coverage limits for GovGazette opportunities, awards, and exclusions? Tell me which snapshots are dated or incomplete.
